issueSummary: The site has credible service basics but feels like a default Wix template, burying trust proof and leaving security buyers without a clear call path.
topFindings: Hero copy is too generic for a high-trust security guard buyer and does not quickly explain service fit.
Visible template leftovers and generic contact flow weaken credibility.
Services and next steps need clearer buyer-intent language before a prospect calls.
preservedDesign: Kept the white Wix-style header, logo/company lockup, red accent color, large hero, dark Why Choose Us section, four-card services rhythm, gallery band, testimonials, and footer contact pattern.
criticalCoverageStatus: All critical findings fixed or improved in the prototype: clearer hero/CTA and removal of template-style internal labels in the cleaned-up page flow.
